title: Cardi B Opens Up Emotionally About Estranged Relationship with Offset: A Candid Revelation
htmlContent:
Cardi B, the chart-topping "I Like It" rapper, recently bared her emotions and shared a candid glimpse into her feelings towards her estranged husband, Offset, in a tear-filled and emotionally charged Instagram Live session that gripped the attention of her followers.

In the aftermath of announcing her separation from Offset, Cardi, 31, unleashed a raw and impassioned tirade during the live session, expressing her vulnerability and frustrations about the situation. In a video captured by The Neighborhood Talk, she confronted her followers, revealing her exasperation with Offset's actions, stating, "This motherf---er really likes to play games with me at my most vulnerable time. When I'm not the most confident."

Her emotions escalated as she accused the 32-year-old rapper of taking advantage of her vulnerability. "You've really been feeling yourself... because of your bitch ass album and s---. And you really been doing me dirty after so many f---ing years that I motherf---ing helped your ass," Cardi emotionally exclaimed, pouring out her grievances. The rapper highlighted the lack of acknowledgment for her support and dedication to Offset.

Expressing her frustration, Cardi conveyed her disappointment at the lack of communication, stating, "And it's so crazy that I have to go to the f---ing internet because whenever I tell you something you don't say s--- to me and I'm so tired of it."

She further vocalized her sentiments on Twitter (now X), accusing Offset and warning him, emphasizing the challenges faced during vulnerable times and hinting at forthcoming actions.

This emotional outburst follows Cardi's revelation of their separation, where she candidly admitted her single status, hinting at indicators in her social media activity and music choices leading up to the split.

An insider, speaking to PEOPLE, shed light on the couple's tumultuous relationship, highlighting their history of breakups and reconciliations, which have occurred more frequently than the public eye has witnessed. Despite the ups and downs, the source emphasized the couple's shared good moments.

Cardi B and Offset tied the knot in a private ceremony in 2017, and their family expanded to include two children, daughter Kulture Kiari and son Wave Set. Their relationship has been a rollercoaster ride of love, support, separations, and reconciliations, garnering both public attention and support through their journey.

As Cardi navigates this tumultuous phase, her emotional transparency offers a candid insight into the complexities of relationships, public scrutiny, and the challenges of navigating love amidst fame and personal struggles. With a desire for a fresh start in the new year, Cardi's openness resonates with many facing similar emotional challenges in their relationships.
